rows.description: The doctor speaks kindly, shows me the stethoscope and lets me listen. I feel less afraid and curious. Being included in what happens makes me feel brave and helps me trust helpers.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, dependence, envy, fear
related mind states: fear, curiosity, trust

rows.description: My sibling is sick and gets all the attention and treats. I feel jealous and even wish I was sick too. This is normal. A wise parent gives me some care time and explains the sick child needs rest.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, dependence, fear, trust
related mind states: envy, jealousy

rows.description: When I am ill I cling to Mummy and do not want her to leave. I feel afraid and helpless. Wise: she stays close when she can and tells me when she will be back. Clinging is a request for safety, not naughtiness.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, envy, fear, trust
related mind states: fear, trust

rows.description: My dog died and I cry and ask where he has gone. I feel a big empty hole and may not understand it is forever. Wise adults tell the truth simply, allow crying and let me draw or say goodbye.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comfort, guilt, indifference
related mind states: sadness, grief

rows.description: My parent hugs me and says "it is okay to be sad, we loved him very much". I feel understood. Not being told to stop crying or to just get a new pet lets grief take its natural path.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: grief, guilt, indifference
related mind states: affection, sadness, grief

rows.description: I think it is my fault because I once forgot to feed him or was angry at him. Young children believe their thoughts can cause things. A wise adult says clearly "it was not because of anything you did".
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comfort, grief, indifference
related mind states: anger, guilt

rows.description: My sister cries for the pet and I feel sad watching her. We hold each other. Sharing sadness with a sibling helps, and a small ritual like planting a flower can give both of us a way to remember him.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comfort, guilt, indifference
related mind states: sadness, grief

rows.description: My friend says "it is just a dog, get another". I feel hurt and misunderstood. Children may not know what to say. A wise response is to tell them "he was my friend"; adults can teach children gentle words.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comfort, grief, guilt
related mind states: hurt

rows.description: Nani has died and I miss her stories and her lap. I feel sad and confused about where she is. Wise adults use simple honest words, allow questions again and again, and keep her memory alive with photos and stories.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, fear, gratitude
related mind states: sadness, grief, confusion

rows.description: I see my father crying and it scares me. I feel worried and quiet. A wise parent says "I am sad because I miss Dadi, it is okay to be sad and I am still here for you". Hiding all grief makes children fear their own.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, fear, gratitude
related mind states: sadness, grief, fear, anxiety
